rule: Do not use concave MeshCollider as Trigger.
fixSummary: Existing concave MeshCollider triggers are neutralized by setting isTrigger=false.
Blocking interaction colliders that are concave MeshColliders are replaced with BoxCollider trigger proxies.
Unknown playable blockers that are concave MeshColliders are disabled instead of converted to triggers.
Support, building, and air-wall colliders remain non-trigger or primitive colliders.
runtimeErrorExpectedAbsent: Triggers on concave MeshColliders are not supported
